summary: Tested the 100-level free-play games on the backend (public-URL runner, 17/17 pass) and in the UI with Playwright (mobile 390x844 and desktop 1920x1080, as a guest and as player1). Everything requested works except one thing: choosing a level did not scroll the page to the top. Clicking level 99 at scrollY=778 opened the instructions at y=-578, off screen, so a mobile user saw only the footer. I fixed it with one line in GamePreview.go() and re-checked: scrollY went from 383 to 0 and the instructions showed at y=200. The iteration_57 regressions all pass.

ui_bugs.issue: Choosing a level did not scroll to the top, so the instructions were off screen on mobile. FIXED by the testing agent: go() now calls window.scrollTo({top:0}).

issues: Minor: the cover image was blank in the first mobile screenshot on a fresh load (still loading). It showed on later loads.

verified: Hub: 10 tier rows practice-tier-1..10 labelled 'Levels 1–10'..'Levels 91–100' with difficulty names (Starter, Easy, Casual, Medium, Challenging, Hard, Very Hard, Expert, Master, Impossible). A fresh guest has only L1 unlocked and tiers 2-10 disabled. Total stars shows 0/300.
The tier holding the next level opens by default: tier 2 after level 10, tier 5 at unlocked=41, tier 10 for player1 at L99.
Time limits for number_sequence: L1 15s, L2 15s, L10 12s, L11 29s (20 numbers), L41 63s (50 numbers), L99 81s (100 numbers). Math Sprint: L11 124s, L12 122s, L15 114s (shrinks inside a tier).
Number count per tier: 10, 20, 50 and 100 buttons. The 100-number board uses 10 columns and fits 390px (scrollWidth 390).
Pass shows practice-pass with 'Congratulations! Level N complete' and 'Play Level N+1'. That opens the level N+1 instructions. Passing L10 unlocks L11 and opens tier 2. Passing L99 unlocks L100.
A timeout on L11 shows practice-fail ('Time's up!') and practice-retry. Retry restarts the countdown.
Quit returns to the instructions. Back on a direct visit goes to /games (location.key fallback).
Each card on /games shows 'N/100 levels': number_sequence 98/100, math_sprint 14/100, pattern_repeat 100/100, an unplayed game '100 levels'.

Backend: level 101 and level 0 return 422, stars 4 returns 422, an unknown game returns 400, an anonymous request returns 401. Skipping ahead of the unlocked level is ignored. A batch of levels 1..100 caps unlocked at 100. Stars keep their highest value. player1 math_sprint was already unlocked to 15.

iteration_57 regressions: GET and POST on the old /api/admin/draw-studio/backdrops return 404. A partial PUT of settings volumes merges with the existing values and is saved (volumes restored afterwards). A player gets 403. The 'drawing' commentary line did not contain the winner display_name that was passed in (it was removed on the server). The DrawTheatre code prefetches the drawing line at mix().
action_items: Keep the scroll-to-top fix in GamePreview.jsx go(). It also covers Retry and Play next level.

Optional: Math Sprint tier-2 time limits (~120s for 6 questions) are very generous. Check that tiers 8-10 really feel 'very hard' for games that are not number_sequence, since only the difficulty setting tightens them.
critical_code_review_comments: practiceProgress.applyLocal hardcodes 100 instead of importing LEVELS. It works but would drift if LEVELS changes.
GET /api/games/practice/progress uses to_list(200). That is fine now (about 30 games) but would silently cut off if the game list grew past 200.
backend/tests/test_practice_progress.py was out of date for 10 levels (level 11 expected 422). Updated to 101, and a check that unlocked caps at 100 was added.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after fix (one bug found and fixed)

seed_data_creation: player1 practice progress changed: number_sequence now unlocked to 100 (levels 1-99 cleared), pattern_repeat all 100 levels cleared (stars 2, L50 = 3). Draw-studio volumes were restored to the original {commentary:0.9, music:0.5}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The pytest conftest only allows loopback, so run /app/tests/run_practice_100_public.py with python after sourcing backend/.env and frontend/.env. It makes one LLM/TTS commentary call; set SKIP_LLM=1 to skip it. To set up guest progress in the UI, set localStorage 'pl-practice-progress' to {gameId:{unlocked,stars}}. Login submit testid: email-submit.
